files.content: The 33 real ciphertext lines of f.3 right page, one stitched image per line (line01=top..line33=bottom). iiif_lines.py detected 37 bands total (centres 568,1316,1444,1792,1922,...,5612,5781,6402); checked each against the debug overlay before use: band 1 (centre 568) is blank upper margin, band 2 (centre 1316) is blank, band 3 (centre 1444) is the "4. januier 1556" date/seal/archival-mark line (not cipher), bands 4-36 (centres 1792..5781, 33 bands) are the real cipher text lines = line01..line33 here, band 37 (centre 6402) is blank lower margin. This corrects the prior handoff note (YX-TR349) that treated the raw 37-band count as ~33 lines by eye-count coincidence without checking which bands were spurious -- the true mapping is offset by 3 at the top and 1 at the bottom, not a uniform eye-count match. Each line image is the two iiif_lines.py segments (s1 full width [0,2400), s2 right-anchored [1495,3895)) re-stitched with the 905px duplicate region trimmed from s1 before concatenation (s1 cropped to [0,1495), then s2 appended), so no token appears twice. The intermediate raw f9right_L*_s1/s2.jpg segment crops and the debug overlay were deleted after this check to stay under the 30MB folder cap; regenerate with the exact command above if needed (deterministic from clair349_f9_right_full.jpg, already on disk).

files.content: 40 X?-token crops and 40 matched-atlas-sign-token crops, fixed seed 42, sampled from the pooled passC.tsv+passD.tsv (593 X? tokens, 570 S0x tokens). No per-token pixel bounding boxes exist for this ciphertext (unlike dupuy452-carpi-1520/glyphs/classified.tsv's real x,y,w,h) -- each crop's window is a PROPORTIONAL ESTIMATE (token position / that pass's token count for the line, times line width), generous but approximate; xq_index.tsv/sign_index.tsv record the estimate window and the pass's own note text for every sampled token so a mis-centred crop can still be judged from the description. Several crops in xq_sheet.jpg/sign_sheet.jpg landed on blank margin or the page's dark binding edge because of this imprecision (documented in NOTES.md ZX-349B, not corrected this pass).

overlap.rule: a token whose centre is left of page x=1950 is counted in s1 only, otherwise in s2 only. The boundary is drawn on every crop as two small red ticks (5x12 px) at the top and bottom edges: s1 x=1950, s2 x=455. Passes stop s1 at the ticks and start s2 at the ticks.
